title: Builder Extended Rate Lock Term Eligibility Matrix
content:
Calloway Home Mortgage offers the Builder Extended Rate Lock in six lock terms, and each term carries its own entry thresholds. The figures below are the thresholds a lock request is measured against for the term requested.

## Thresholds by lock term

| Lock term | Lock term days | Earliest construction stage | Minimum qualifying credit score | Highest qualifying debt-to-income | Highest loan-to-value | Loan programs that may use the term | Minimum days from request to estimated completion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 60 | finishes | 620 | 50% | 97% | conventional, fha, va, usda, jumbo | 0 |
| 90-Day Lock | 90 | drywall | 620 | 50% | 97% | conventional, fha, va, usda, jumbo | 0 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 120 | framing | 640 | 45% | 95% | conventional, fha, va, usda, jumbo | 60 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 180 | foundation | 660 | 45% | 95% | conventional, fha, va, usda, jumbo | 90 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 270 | not started | 680 | 43% | 90% | conventional, fha, va | 180 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 360 | not started | 700 | 43% | 90% | conventional, va | 270 |

## Thresholds common to every term

| Item | All six terms |
|---|---|
| Purchase agreement must be ratified before a lock is requested | Yes |
| Loan amount above which the loan is a jumbo loan (conforming limit) | USD 832750.00 |
| Largest loan amount accepted on any lock | USD 2000000.00 |

## Column meanings

- **Lock term days** — the calendar days from the lock date to the lock expiration date.
- **Earliest construction stage** — the earliest construction stage of the home at which the term may be requested.
- **Minimum qualifying credit score / highest qualifying debt-to-income** — the qualifying figures for the term, taken from the credit report on file and the loan application.
- **Highest loan-to-value** — the highest loan-to-value percent accepted for the term.
- **Minimum days from request to estimated completion** — the minimum calendar days from the lock request to the purchase agreement's estimated completion date for the term.

## Reading the matrix

- Only the two Build Lock terms list not started as their earliest construction stage; the 270-Day Build Lock does not accept usda or jumbo loans, and the 360-Day Build Lock accepts only conventional and va loans.
- The conforming limit and the largest loan amount are the same figures on every term of the Builder Extended Rate Lock.
